name: Nox Ground Unit
title: Nox Ground Unit
note: Box W frame (X across, Y along the axle toward the front, Z up; the swap arm hub at the origin, the drone seat at (0, 167.1, 220.3): the catch's SEAT_TO_W raised 65, the arm's head extending 65 more at the drone slot, Spark 3 Nov). In: the swap arm v7 at park with 11 bay receivers, every slot of the ring but the drone's (8 Nov) and two packs, a placeholder extended head at the drone, the stand of the built demo, the v2 enclosure sheets to W Z 145 and the PSU as boxes, the funnel on its nose and tail beams across the side sheets, its end walls sliding in for the Scout and out for the Overseer, the Scout under a folding rain and dust dome (five carbon hoops on one hinge axis, a folding-fan linkage, two worm motors) on the box's rain lid (9 Nov, after noxensys.com's dock; the Overseer lands with it open; the Scout drawn is still v3 with its runners, which go: the walls cut through them until the Scout's base is redrawn), both drones seated in it. Out: the v1 ring frames, posts, brackets and bay modules (superseded by the v2 layout, whose bodies are not drawn), the hold-down, the electronics. The nox repo's own master page of the box: https://claude.ai/artifact/RX2CexkfhB5UoQHnGTVgCC (27 Oct). Imported by tools/import_box.py from sparkiscool/nox.
